grounded-01.summary: Exact proposed normalization collapses finite binary-mask features and yields NaNs on constant columns. This is an operator diagnostic, not a predictive benchmark.

grounded-02.summary: Shared weights are covered by NeuMiss 2021. In a supplementary inverse-operator diagnostic, standard Richardson and Chebyshev controls outperform the scalar-coefficient candidate at matched polynomial degree. No trained-network or novelty claim.

grounded-03.summary: The literal iteration converges to the wrong inverse operator even after global rescaling. Corrected Jacobi is equivalent to standardization in this diagnostic. No predictive or novelty claim.

grounded-interface-v2.summary: At identical resident precision counts, 1-bit mean-logit ranking had higher local attention-output error than exact prompt-attention mass on both exposed SmolVLM images (0.02518 vs 0.01510; 0.02229 vs 0.01510). Fixed-budget development gate failed. Generic visual-token chunk surrogate, not a WindowQuant/FIER replication. No end-to-end quality, speed or novelty claim.

grounded-contract-v1.summary: One-bit max lowers relative L2 slightly on two exposed images but remains worse than exact attention mass; cosine worsens slightly on candy. Original controls reproduce exactly. This is local teacher-forced replay, not an end-to-end task or speed result.

grounded-systems-v1.summary: Amazon/DBLP development walks: varint uses 25.0% / 21.1% more bytes than fixed-width packing even with a free resident rank dictionary; charging the dictionary worsens it. All 280 round trips exact. Static walks, not FeLoG training; no GPU, speed, energy or novelty claim.

grounded-claim-pilot-v1.summary: Amazon/DBLP development walks: varint uses 25.0% / 21.1% more bytes than fixed-width packing even with a free resident rank dictionary; charging the dictionary worsens it. All 280 round trips exact. Static walks, not FeLoG training; no GPU, speed, energy or novelty claim.

grounded-gnn-gate-v1.summary: Sync-revealed Fixed Share has 2.086x / 2.014x predictor-only relative L2 error on ordinary / LR-drop Cora screening trajectories. Both frozen 5% gates fail. Offline real-GCN replay, not closed-loop accuracy, SNI replication or general rejection of adaptive methods.

grounded-optimizer-v1.summary: Full Newton-Muon has better fixed-step and matched-time held-out endpoints in both seeds but worse normalized full-curve loss/time area. Frozen strict continuation rule fails; local approximation work closed at these settings. No low-rank candidate or novelty validated.

grounded-serving-v2.summary: Corrected state-machine checks pass on five exposed toy traces. Largest-prompt-first loses7vs6 to smallest-reservation on a two-request counterexample. No efficacy, hardware or novelty claim; baseline and threshold revisions remain.
